section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Forms of Self-criticizing and Self-reassuring Scale (FSCRS), a 22-item self-report instrument used to assess critical and reassuring evaluative responses to failures and setbacks. The text reports Cronbach's alpha reliability coefficients for the original study and Portuguese version, and notes that the current study used only the self-reassurance subscale with a Cronbach alpha of 0.91. No study-specific demographic or outcome data is provided in this section.
